name: Amara Okonkwo
title: CEO & Co-founder
context_notes: Managers approve up to 5 consecutive days. Anything over 10 consecutive days needs the CEO. She wants the tool to be Slack-first and simple. No more than 2 people out on the same team at once.

name: Daniel Reyes
title: COO & Head of People
context_notes: Policy: 20 PTO days and 5 sick days per year. PTO requests of 3 or more consecutive days need 2 weeks notice. Sick days need no notice. Max 5 unused PTO days carry over to the next year. Company holidays are tracked separately and don't count against PTO.

name: Hannah Cho
title: CTO & Co-founder
context_notes: Internal tools should be a single-page web app in TypeScript with Google Workspace login. No new paid vendors. Employee data must not be exposed publicly. Keep the codebase small and tested.

name: Marcus Webb
title: Senior Software Engineer
context_notes: Suggested data model: requests(id, employee_email, start_date, end_date, type, status, approver_email, created_at). Status values: pending, approved, denied, cancelled. Prefers a small repo with unit tests for the day-counting and balance logic.

name: Marc Webb

name: Leila Farouk
title: Frontend Engineer
context_notes: Wants a team calendar view showing who is out, with a mobile-friendly layout and keyboard accessibility. Counting days must skip weekends and company holidays.

name: Tom Aldrich
title: Design Lead
context_notes: Brand: teal accent (#0F766E), Inter font, lots of white space. Status colors: pending amber, approved green, denied red. One primary action per screen.

name: Sophie Lindgren
title: Finance & Payroll Manager
context_notes: PTO accrues at about 1.67 days per month. Balances currently live in a Google Sheet called PTO Balances. Payroll runs on the 1st and 15th and needs a CSV export of approved days. Unused days above the carryover cap are forfeited on Dec 31.

name: Raj Patel
title: Head of Sales
context_notes: Sales cannot take PTO during the last two weeks of each quarter without his approval. He wants to see the sales team's requests before approving.

name: Nina Alvarez
title: Customer Success Lead
context_notes: At least one Customer Success person must be working at all times. She needs to see overlaps on a team calendar before approving.

name: Jordan Kim
title: Operations Associate
context_notes: Can add a /timeoff Slack slash command and sync approved days to Google Calendar. Slack notifications should go to the approver and the requester.
